subject: Important Update on Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We wanted to inform you that there has been a slight schedule change to your upcoming flight reservation. Your flight now departs at 2:00 PM instead of the previously scheduled time. Please ensure you arrive at the airport accordingly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. Thank you for choosing to fly with us! Best regards, The Airline Team
